verdict.rationale: The API supplies building blocks for background, autonomous work. The Batch API runs asynchronous request groups with a 24-hour turnaround, and a managed Codex harness handles session orchestration, compaction and recovery for agents. The Agents SDK supports orchestration, and agents can plan and complete tasks with tools across steps. There is no evidence of a first-class way to schedule, trigger or run automations unattended, so the developer must build and host that layer. Missing for 10: scheduled or triggered automation primitives, a documented background or long-running agent execution mode, independent hands-on corroboration of autonomous runs.
